命题 2.2. Let 1≤p≤∞, μ∈M(Rn), ∀f∈Lp(Rn), the convolution f∗μ exists for Ln-a.e. x, and∥f∗μ∥Lp(Rn)​≤∥f∥Lp(Rn)​∥μ∥.(1)

引理 2.6. Let μ,ν∈M(Rn). If μ^​=ν^, then μ=ν.

证明. Let {φε​} be an approximate identity. με​:=φε​∗μ→μ weakly. If μ^​=0, then μ^​ε​=φ^​ε​μ^​=0. Recalling that με​∈Cc∞​, we have με​=0. As a result, μ=0.

□

Given μ∈M(Rn) we μ≪Ln, we can find f∈L1(Rn) such that dμ=f dLn. If there is no risk of confusion, we identify μ and f.

定理 2.7. Let μ∈M(Rn). If μ^​∈L2(Rn), then μ∈L2(Rn).

证明. As the Fourier transform is an isometry on L2(Rn), we can find f∈L2(Rn) such that f^​=μ^​. This implies that μ^​ε​=f^​ε​ where fε​=f∗φε​. Since fε​→f in L2(Rn), we have fε​→f weakly. Recalling that με​→μ weakly, we have μ=f.

□

5Falconer’s distance set conjecture

Given a finite subset P⊂R2 of N points, we define the associated distance setΔ(P):={∣x−y∣:x,y∈P}.

命题 5.1. Let P={(m,n)∈Z2:0≤m,n≤N​}, then ∣∣​Δ(P)≥ClogN​N​∣∣​.

猜想 5.2 (Distinct Distance). Suppose that P⊂R2 is a set of N points. Then∣Δ(P)∣≥ClogN​N​.Guth-Katz 2015: ∣Δ(P)∣≥ClogNN​.

u2​(N):=∣P∣=Nsup​∣{(x,y)∈P×P:∣x−y∣=1}∣.

猜想 5.3 (Unit Distance). u2​(N)≤CNlogN​.

注 5.4. Conjecture 2 ⟹ Conjecture 1. In fact,N2​=#{(x,y):x,y∈P}=d∈Δ(P)∑​∑1≤∣Δ(P)∣u2​(N).​

Now replace P with arbitrary Borel set E⊂R2, Δ(E):={∣x−y∣:x,y∈E}⊂R. Is dim(Δ(E))=min{dimE,1} true?

猜想 5.5 (Falconer). Suppose E⊂Rn is Borel with dimE>2n​. Then∣Δ(E)∣>0.In particular,dimΔ(E)=1.

定理 5.6. If dimE>2n+1​, then the interior of Δ(E) is non-empty. In particular, ∣Δ(E)∣>0.

To prove Theorem 5.6, we introduce some notations first. π(x,y):=∣x−y∣, π:E×E→Δ(E), π introduces a measure on R, the push-forward measure of μ×μ,δμ​δμ​(B)​:=(π)♯​(μ×μ),=(μ×μ)(π−1B).​It’s clear that⟨δμ​,φ⟩=∬E×E​φ(∣x−y∣) dμ(x)dμ(y),∀φ∈Cc​(R),therefore suppδμ​⊂Δ(E). Denote σr​ for the Hausdorff measure on Srn−1​:={x∈Rn:∣x∣=r}. Let φr​(x):=rn−1φ(rx), then⟨σr​,φ⟩=⟨σ,φr​⟩,andσ^r​(ξ)=σ^(rξ)rn−1.

引理 5.7. σ^(ξ)=∣ξ∣2n−2​2π​J2n−2​​(2π∣ξ∣), where the Bessel function Jα​ of order α is defined byJα​(t):=Γ(α+21​)Γ(21​)(2t​)α​∫−11​eits(1−s2)α−1/2 dsfor Reα>−21​,t≥0. In particular, ∣σ^(ξ)∣≤C(1+∣ξ∣)−2n−1​.

证明. We consider first the case when dμ=fdLn, where f∈Cc​(Rn) is non-negative and real-valued.
